//: Template. Copy to appsettings.Production.json, fill in the real values, and keep that copy
out of git - it is already in .gitignore. ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production (set by the
systemd unit) makes ASP.NET load it automatically on top of appsettings.json, so nothing
here needs to be passed as an environment variable.
It is picked up by `dotnet publish` and shipped in the bundle, so fill it in before publishing
and treat the bundle as carrying live credentials.
Database must be smpp_bulk_db_new - the database the legacy Laravel app and the SMPP daemon
share. The daemon polls under_process there; pointed anywhere else the app accepts sends that
Signing key for the REST API's bearer tokens. The app refuses to start until it is set to
at least 32 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 48
Changing it invalidates every token already issued, which is how you revoke them all.

Api.//: PublicBaseUrl is the domain the API is published on; it becomes the server in the OpenAPI document.

Seed.//: Applied on first boot only. Without these the superadmin is created as admin/ChangeMe123!.

Email.//: SMTP relay for spam-keyword-blocked alerts (SpamKeywordFilterService). SmtpPort 465 with UseSsl true is implicit TLS - what the legacy Laravel app's mail.hle-jo.com relay uses.
